==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:af|re-|produce|tree=1|text=+}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌɹiː.pɹəˈdjuːs/|/ˌɹiː.pɹəˈd͡ʒuːs/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|En-uk-reproduce.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌɹi.pɹəˈdus/|a=GenAm}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-reproduce.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uːs|s=3}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[produce]] an [[image]] or [[copy]] of.
# {{lb|en|transitive|or|intransitive|biology}} To [[generate]] or [[propagate]] [[offspring]] or [[organism]]s [[sexually]] or [[asexually]].
#* {{quote-web|en|title=Constitutional Court’s full verdict enrages LGBT community, rights defenders|date=2021-12-03|accessdate=2021-12-04|location=Bangkok|work=Thai PBS World|author=Thai PBS|publisher=Thai Public Broadcasting Service|url=https://www.thaipbsworld.com/constitutional-courts-full-verdict-enrages-lgbt-community-rights-defenders/|passage=The 12-page ruling notes that “Marriage is when a man and a woman are willing to live together, to build a husband and wife relationship to '''reproduce''' their offspring {{...}} . Marriage is, therefore, reserved for only a man and a woman.” Other parts in the verdict also mention that members of the LGBTQIA+ community cannot '''reproduce''', as it is against nature, and that people of those communities are no different to other animals with strange behaviours or physical features.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20240703005112/https://www.thaipbsworld.com/constitutional-courts-full-verdict-enrages-lgbt-community-rights-defenders/|archivedate=3 July 2024}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To produce [[again]]; to [[recreate]].
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To bring something to [[mind]]; to [[recall]].
